title: Sales chart sums competing sources
observed_evidence: 8 of 8 multi-source chart-input dates differ from resolved values
business_impact: Revenue inconsistent with dashboards
recommended_action: Use resolved trend and retain source observations table

title: CTB recipe failure blocks later datasets
observed_evidence: 5 PARTIAL runs fail non-JSON getAllRecipes; 0 recipes and downstream payloads
business_impact: Inventory supplier count wastage coverage absent
recommended_action: Diagnose authorised external response contract and isolate dataset attempts

title: Invoice number not globally unique
observed_evidence: 1174 source invoice IDs / 1172 number keys; 2 cross-supplier collisions; 2 CSV collision keys
business_impact: Suppliers and invoices can merge overwrite or misattribute spend
recommended_action: Retain stable source IDs supplier scope and line-to-invoice keys

title: Invoice controls disagree
observed_evidence: 97 of 1167 header-ex-tax totals differ from line sums over one cent; freight does not explain
business_impact: Purchasing accuracy and reconciliations untrustworthy
recommended_action: Explain and quarantine differences using identity tax discount and source controls

title: Ordinal identities leave stale or duplicated candidates
observed_evidence: 1 current sequence-tail beyond latest parseable CSV length; 18 repeat groups / 79 excess candidate lines
business_impact: Obsolete or ambiguous lines may inflate purchases
recommended_action: Verify replacement semantics and stable source-line matching; do not delete candidates blindly

title: Raw SUCCESS is not transform success
observed_evidence: Push runs complete before parsers and PDF enrichment; 24 Lightspeed SUCCESS including 8 empty dated reports
business_impact: Silent parse/canonical/projection failures can look healthy
recommended_action: Add dataset-stage accounting and post-raw terminal outcomes

title: Stable entities and recipe links stranded raw
observed_evidence: 30 invoice AJAX pages and 20 link pages; 639 links and 445 recipe IDs
business_impact: Existing integrations cannot be used for relationship traversal
recommended_action: Canonicalise source IDs links and effective active mappings

title: Populated product cost tax discount fields dropped
observed_evidence: 8704 latest nonzero food-cost observations and 502 raw stock codes discarded
business_impact: Source-estimated margin and tax discount analysis hidden
recommended_action: Preserve rich source-product-day observations with request windows

title: Freshness conflates all CTB datasets
observed_evidence: Latest CSV SUCCESS Oct 9 masks latest web PARTIAL Oct 8; PARTIAL not SOURCE_FAILURE
business_impact: Fresh labels may apply to datasets not delivered
recommended_action: Track freshness by dataset/window and last queryable completion

title: Ingestion completeness measures run cleanliness
observed_evidence: 2698 clean of 2719 terminal runs -> 99%; 2654 are PDF writes
business_impact: Owner sees high completeness despite source gaps
recommended_action: Rename proxy and add grain-aware source/stage completeness

title: Lightspeed products use arrival date
observed_evidence: LocalDate.now assigns report date; zero product deliveries observed
business_impact: Delayed/backfilled multi-day reports would be misattributed
recommended_action: Require explicit report date/window and validate it before enabling

title: Independent business valid-time not implemented
observed_evidence: 31684 versions valid_from equals recorded_at; all valid_to null
business_impact: As-of business-effective analysis can overcount or exclude old periods
recommended_action: Define time axes and add correct current/system/as-of views

title: Purchasing and blended UOM labelled as costing
observed_evidence: All categories null; unit quantity missing 84.49%; purchases/gross labelled food cost
business_impact: Margin COGS and ingredient unit costs can be misinterpreted
recommended_action: Separate purchase spend consumption COGS category tax/unit basis and confidence

title: Reservation Covers Trace unsupported
observed_evidence: Frontend requests reservations.covers provenance but backend allows only sales metrics
business_impact: Drilldown would fail when real covers arrive
recommended_action: Implement authorised reservation lineage or suppress unsupported Trace

title: Unauthenticated API redirects blur session failure
observed_evidence: GET data endpoints return 302 login even JSON Accept; followed response HTML
business_impact: Session expiry appears unreadable response rather than permission denial
recommended_action: Return typed API 401/403 and handle session expiry explicitly

title: Explorer and metrics lack relational query interface
observed_evidence: 10/5 fixed registries; 26 compiled metrics; 4 dashboards/7 predefined-query widgets
business_impact: Novel joins formulas and saved relational questions require Java
recommended_action: Add typed authorised metadata/query plan and versioned definitions

title: Major domains have no received data
observed_evidence: Deputy OpenTable counts wastage recipes stock dedicated datasets absent
business_impact: Staff reservation recipe and consumption questions impossible
recommended_action: Obtain real approved source contracts and manifest complete windows
